newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - New Danish T-bill seen yielding 4.43 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - New Danish T-bill seen yielding 4.43 pct.

text.p: The Danish state's four percent treasury note, due to go on sale at 1000 GMT on Tuesday, is likely to have an opening yield of 4.43 percent before tax, according to analyses from Danish banks Unibank and BG Bank.

BG Bank bases its forecast on a gap of 27 basis points below a theoretical curve of state paper yields, calculated on January 2. Unibank arrives at the same forecast by working on the basis of a 20 point gap below a curve of all instruments.
The low coupon holds tax benefits for Danish investors and also for some foreign buyers, such as German pension funds. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
